name: io.github.vibebytes/vibe3d
title: vibe3d
description: Edit and render 3D scenes over MCP: rooms, nodes, materials, cameras, and snapshots.

environmentVariables.name: VIBE3D_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Daemon auth token. Prefer this over a command-line flag.

environmentVariables.name: VIBE3D_CHROME
environmentVariables.description: Chrome or Chromium executable. Rendering needs a system browser.

environmentVariables.name: VIBE3D_ROOM
environmentVariables.description: Room id bound when the server starts
